about: Script camera sets for every camera id the client hard-codes and every id the statues' tactical action sets request (tools/content/build_camera_sets.py, docs/research/31-battle-camera.md): each requested id plays the shot measured for it in the original footage, or one chosen by the kind of action and the role of the states that request it with the measured frequencies; normal attacks glide (inter 0.09), skills and SPs cut (inter 1.0); win shots (301-314, 101001-101028) a still facing shot; the boss intro (201) a crane up to a tilted full-body shot; stage finishes (100300-100311, 350/351) a ground-level shot. flagMaintain stays false so each shot ends on its own.
